about.title: About Betar News
about.intro: Bangladesh Betar is the national public-service broadcaster, connecting people with trusted news, culture and essential information.
about.section1Body: Betar News reports in the public interest. We aim to make national developments understandable, useful and accessible to audiences across Bangladesh.
about.section2Body: Our digital newsroom brings together national updates and regional voices while the audio service preserves Bangladesh Betar’s broadcast heritage.
about.section3Body: English and Bangla presentation are built into the platform so audiences can choose the language that works for them.

contact.title: Contact Betar News
contact.intro: Send verified information, corrections and official newsroom enquiries to Bangladesh Betar.
contact.section1Body:
Bangladesh Betar
31 Syed Mahbub Morshed Sarani
Sher-e-Bangla Nagar, Agargaon
Dhaka 1207, Bangladesh
contact.section3Body: For platform support, accessibility feedback or a general message, use the Help and Support page available from the shared portal header.

advertise.title: Advertise with Bangladesh Betar
advertise.intro: The News portal includes clearly labelled, layout-stable inventory prepared for responsible display advertising.
advertise.section1Body: Responsive leaderboard, in-article and 300 × 250 sidebar placements are reserved without covering editorial content or causing layout shift.
advertise.section2Body: Advertising must be lawful, clearly distinguishable from reporting and appropriate for a Bangladesh Government public-service platform.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Bangladesh Betar is committed to handling audience information transparently and in line with applicable government requirements.
privacy.section1Body: The service may process technical logs needed for security, reliability and aggregate audience measurement. Account details are used to provide requested member features.
privacy.section2Body: Article popularity uses an aggregate counter. The News portal does not need a reader’s name to update a story’s read count.
privacy.section3Body: When advertising is enabled, third-party providers may process information under their own policies. Advertising remains clearly labelled.
privacy.section4Body: You can change language and theme without creating an account. Contact Bangladesh Betar with privacy questions or requests.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain the responsible use of Bangladesh Betar’s public digital news service.
terms.section1Body: You may access published reporting for personal and informational use. Do not misuse the service, attempt unauthorised access or interfere with its operation.
terms.section2Body: News is provided for public information. Developing stories may change as verified information becomes available.
terms.section3Body: Bangladesh Betar text, audio, video, images and branding remain protected by applicable law unless another rights holder is identified.
terms.section4Body: The service and these terms may be updated. Use is governed by the applicable laws of Bangladesh.

editorialPolicy.title: Editorial policy
editorialPolicy.intro: The Betar newsroom serves the public through accuracy, fairness, context and visible accountability.
editorialPolicy.section1Body: We verify material facts and clearly identify developing information. Headlines should accurately reflect the reporting they introduce.
editorialPolicy.section2Body: Coverage should include relevant context, avoid unnecessary harm and give affected parties a reasonable opportunity to respond.
editorialPolicy.section3Body: Material errors should be corrected promptly and transparently. Readers can send correction requests through the newsroom contact page.
editorialPolicy.section4Body: Paid placements are labelled as advertisements and do not determine the conclusions of Bangladesh Betar reporting.
